title: Grateful Dead Live at Assembly Hall, University of Illinois on 1973-02-21

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a strong Feb ’73 Dead show, but the file mixes two dates causing sync and flow issues; performance shines especially on the Eyes of the World transition.
ai_review.review: The performances are praised as well‑played and energetic, with highlights like the Truckin’ jam into Eyes of the World, Phil’s solo, and a smooth segue into Stella Blue. The SBD offers good balance and clarity, though listeners note it is noisy at times and out‑of‑sync because material from 2/21 and 2/22 has been combined, which makes the set flow confusing.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating (~3.3) across six reviews; strong musical praise offsets recording‑mix issues, yielding a mid‑range overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced SBD with a bit of hiss/noise; however the tracks are out‑of‑sync because material from two consecutive shows (2/21 & 2/22) was merged, leading to occasional timing hiccups.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The musical flow is strong with memorable transitions (e.g., Truckin' jam → Eyes), but the mixed‑date compilation disrupts the natural set progression and confuses listeners.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Delivers a short, nice solo after the Eyes transition.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for an expressive bass solo during the Eyes of the World jam.
